metaDescription: The browser has no network. %PRODUCT_DESIGN% keeps drawing locally and holds a recovery draft; anything that needs the server waits until the connection comes back.
title: You are offline
intro: %PRODUCT_DESIGN% served this screen from your own machine. Nothing is lost: the editor runs entirely in the browser and keeps a local draft while the connection is away.

works.drawBody: The 2D engine and the faceted 3D modeler never ask the server to trace a line, resolve an object snap or push a face.
works.journalBody: Every tab writes to its own lane and keeps its last {checkpoints} checkpoints. A draft is still offered for {days} days after it was written.
works.retryTitle: The retry when the network returns
works.retryBody: As soon as the browser is back online the pending save fires by itself. Nobody has to remember to press Save.

blockedTitle: What cannot happen without a network

blocked.saveBody: The write fails and the drawing stays marked with pending changes. There is a single save queue, so nothing is duplicated once it goes through.
blocked.blocksBody: The block catalog lives on the server. Blocks already inserted in this drawing can still be placed and edited.
blocked.reviewBody: Opening, creating or closing a review session needs the server, and the reviewer on the other end sees nothing until the connection comes back.

warningBody: In this browser and this profile, not in your account. Opening the same drawing on another machine will not find it, and clearing the site data deletes it.
